get.description: Returns tasks visible to the caller, optionally filtered by type and creation time.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Return only tasks created strictly after this simulation time.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Return only tasks created strictly before this simulation time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous request.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the created task.

get.description: Returns a single task by its identifier.

put.description: Replaces the mutable representation of an existing task.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing task.

get.description: Returns developers visible to the caller.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of developers to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous request.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the created developer.

get.description: Returns a single developer by its identifier.

put.description: Replaces the mutable representation of an existing developer.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing developer.

post.description: Creates a batch of developers using server-side generation rules that mirror DeveloperFactory.create().

Location.description: Canonical URL for the created developer batch.

get.description: Returns a single developer batch and the developers it generated.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Returns a single QA tester by its identifier.

put.description: Replaces the mutable representation of an existing QA tester.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing QA tester.

get.description: Returns toolchains visible to the caller.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of toolchains to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous request.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the created toolchain.

get.description: Returns a single toolchain by its identifier.

put.description: Replaces the mutable representation of an existing toolchain.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing toolchain.

bad_request.description: The request body or parameters are invalid.

not_found.description: The requested task does not exist.

conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the task collection.

task.title: Task
task.description: A unit of delivery in the simulation with depreciating value, accumulated work, and workflow history.

initial_value.description: Initial relative value assigned when the task is created.

story_points.description: Estimated relative effort required to complete the task.

completed_story_points.description: Amount of work already applied to the task.

depreciation_rate.description: Fraction of value lost per unit of simulation time.

task_id.description: Optional public identifier for this task.

creation_t.description: Simulation time when the task was created.

task_type.description: Task category used by scheduling and prioritization logic.

loss.description: Delivered value expressed as a fraction of initial value minus 1. Undelivered tasks remain 0.

delivered_value.description: Depreciated value at successful delivery time. Undelivered tasks remain 0.

task_create_request.title: TaskCreateRequest
task_create_request.description: Payload used to create a task.

task_replace_request.title: TaskReplaceRequest
task_replace_request.description: Full mutable representation used to replace a task.

task_patch_request.title: TaskPatchRequest
task_patch_request.description: Partial mutable representation used to update a task.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: A software developer resource that performs work on tasks.

resource_id.description: System-generated identifier for the developer resource.

name.description: Optional display name for the developer.

efficiency.description: Relative rate at which the developer converts time into completed story points.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

prefix.description: Prefix used when generating developer names.

start_index.description: Starting index used by the generated name sequence.

values.description: Ordered efficiency values consumed one developer at a time.

developer_efficiency_spec.title: DeveloperEfficiencySpec
developer_efficiency_spec.description: Either a fixed efficiency applied to every generated developer, or a generation strategy that produces one efficiency per developer.

developer_batch_create_request.title: DeveloperBatchCreateRequest
developer_batch_create_request.description: Instructions for creating a batch of developers using factory-style generation rules.

developer_batch.title: DeveloperBatch
developer_batch.description: A batch resource representing one factory-style developer generation request and its resulting developers.

batch_id.description: System-generated identifier for the developer batch.

count.description: Number of developers requested for creation.

qa_tester.title: QATester
qa_tester.description: A QA testing resource that validates tasks and can fail or cause remediation work.

resource_id.description: System-generated identifier for the QA tester resource.

time_cost.description: Time multiplier applied to the task story points during QA work.

failure_rate.description: Probability that QA work ends in failure.

failure_cost.description: Fraction of task story points removed as remediation when QA fails.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

toolchain.title: Toolchain
toolchain.description: An SDLC tooling resource used for deployment-stage work.

resource_id.description: System-generated identifier for the toolchain resource.

deployment_duration.description: Elapsed time for one deployment attempt.

failure_rate.description: Probability that a deployment attempt fails.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

event.description: Identifies the workflow state associated with this event

baseline_t.description: Offset subtracted from raw simulation timestamps before events are recorded.

events.description: Chronological event log for the task.

details.description: Optional structured metadata describing the error.
